David and Brigid point out that reality tv doesn't cost anything because it is, as it sounds, very low budget.
No writing , no special expertise or knowledge or research , no archival footage , no copyright clearance , no actors, no travel beyond the one location, certainly no clinton or woody allen or justice elena kagan or david brooks or Lena Dunham or even Professor New.
